etymology: a dual (in allusion to its two main hills [the true pointing, at least of the former reading, seems to be that of 03390]), probably from (the passive participle of) 03384 and 07999, Greek 2414 _*Ierosoluma*_ and 2419 _*Ierousalhm*_
definition:
Jerusalem = "teaching of peace"

 1) the chief city of Palestine and capital of the united kingdom and
    the nation of Judah after the split
